title: The `reconnect` member of the 200 answer of GET /v1/devices/authorize (the relay path), WP21 reads it and WP26 writes it. Absent for a computer that must never see the card (Lifetime without updates, a legacy credential, a network that blocks 443, a computer that is not on 2.x, a computer whose encrypted path is not ready) and for every computer while the kill switch is on or the retirement criteria are not met. `eligible`: it can reach 2.x, its own self-check passed and it has not moved yet. `migrated`: it served a tool call on its encrypted address; `since` is that moment in epoch milliseconds. `locale` is the language the person signed up in (absent when unknown).
